The '''Decorative Trash Can''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can be obtained by [[Fishing#Presents|fishing]] in the fountain west of the [[Community Center]] (10% chance).<ref name="trashcanchance" /> Multiple trash cans can be obtained. 

It can also be found in the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

Although the Decorative Trash Can is almost identical in appearance to the [[Garbage Can|trash cans]] found outside buildings in [[Pelican Town]], it cannot be interacted with in the same way. If placed outside, it does not change appearance for the seasons.
